feeds.title: Stitching Farm Girl Blog
feeds.description: I mostly do patchwork and quilting and all things related but have been known to do lots of different things over the years. This blog is full of my quilting thoughts and inspirations sprinkled with a glimpse of life down on the farm. I'm Raewyn; a Mum to three grown children, Ganma to eight, and wife to a lovely dairy farmer. I love the farm and my animals, my quilting, crafting, reading, blogging and much, much more.

feeds.title: Quiltingorchardist Blog
feeds.description: Quilting is a wonderful hobby for me. I love the beautiful fabric and colors - my artistic side comes alive. I have lived in Te Puna near Tauranga since 1978. Recently retired after 40 years working on our own small orchard where we grew Kiwifruit and Avocados for export. I love to create and am currently passionate about patchwork and quilting. I sew by hand and using my Bernina Aurora 440 machine. Check out my quilts, completed and in-progress, patterns tutorials and more!

feeds.title: Quilt Me Kiwi Blog
feeds.description: My name is Leeanne Hopper. I operate my home-based machine quilting business since 2008. Know more about the quilts I make, patterns, techniques and more!

feeds.title: Mystic Quilter Blog
feeds.description: I'm Maureen sharing my life with my family and my fabric stash! Join me as I write down tales of my quilts, pattern tutorials, guides and more in this blog.

feeds.title: Romany Quilting Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog where I will share my love of patchwork and quilting, home and family, including Muffy our cat. I love all aspects of quilting and seem to have a large collection of UFOs. We love to travel and discovering new quilt shops is always a bonus. Stop and read what I am getting up to. Welcome to tales of my stitching life, home, family and friends.

feeds.title: Kokaquilts Blog
feeds.description: Hi I'm Linda, I am a mother of two grown-up children & granny to three now! The sewing part of my life needed its own public space so here is where it begins. I'm looking forward to sharing my quilty makes with you! Follow along as I quilt new patterns, designs and more!

feeds.title: Aotearoa Quilters
feeds.description: Aotearoa Quilters,the National Association of New Zealand Quilters and Textile Artists. Originally founded in 1994 as the National Association of New Zealand Quilters(NANZQ) we rebranded the association to Aotearoa Quilters in 2011. As the National Association of New Zealand quilters, Aotearoa Quilters provides a point of connection nationally, runs regular challenges and exhibitions, and has many exciting events planned for the next twelve months. Find out more about our events here.

feeds.title: Wendy's Quilts And More Blog
feeds.description: Hello, and welcome. I'm Wendy Welsh and I'm a modern hand quilter from New Zealand. I love working with bright colors. I learned to sew at a young age and I've been sewing ever since. I enjoy embroidery as well as quilting and feature both on my blog.

feeds.title: Delbrook Quilt Company Blog
feeds.description: Be the first to know about new fabric, classes, kits, events and happenings with us. We are online as well as our gorgeous shop in Hastings. Find stunning fabrics, patterns, kits, notions and all the bits and bobs you need to make your next project.

feeds.title: Quilt Shops Blog
feeds.description: Quilt Shops is a directory of quilters from all over New Zealand and their blogs. Check out our blog for more information on quilting, patterns, global quilting techniques, fabrics and more!

feeds.title: Patchwork Passion NZ Blog
feeds.description: Patchwork Passion is a business specializing in mail orders of Japanese fabrics and projects. I am Robyn, owner of Patchwork Passion. I spend my days working with fabric, helping customers plan their next quilt project, enjoying their Show 'n' Tell quilts and running various quilt groups. Know more about the projects, new quilts for sale and more!

feeds.title: Sheila Christensen Quilt Blog
feeds.description: I'm Sheila Christensen, author of two books published by C&T, shop owner, quilt designer, ruler designer for Creative Grids and teacher. I am crazy about quilting and love problem-solving. I have developed an easy grid-based way to work with equilateral triangles and other sixty-degree shapes using Creative Grids rulers, but I love trying out new things and teaching a wide range of patchwork and quilting techniques to my students. Explore my blog as I quilt to my heart's content and post about the patters, step by step guides, tutorials and more!

feeds.title: Susannasquilts Blog
feeds.description: I am a wife, mother, stepmother and grandma, and have been addicted to quilting since 1990. I absolutely love Antique Quilts, and hexagons are probably my favorite. Explore my quilts as I share my journey, designs, patters, step-by-ste guides and more!
